sys_update_xml.name: sysevent_script_action_2cbb53c983d70710b5309e80ceaad3a7
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sysevent_script_action"><sysevent_script_action action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><condition_script/><description/><event_name>x_2215032_ai_inc_0.s1_3_outbound_event</event_name><name>AI Incident Orchestrator - Send S1.3 Eve</name><order>100</order><script><![CDATA[(function executeAction(current, event) {

    try {
        var endpointProperty = 'x_2215032_ai_inc_0.s1_3_event_endpoint';
        var endpoint = String(gs.getProperty(endpointProperty, '')).trim();

        if (!endpoint) {
            gs.error(
                'S1.3 outbound event endpoint is not configured: ' +
                endpointProperty
            );
            return;
        }

        var outboundEvent = {
            event_id: String(event.parm1),
            sys_id: current.getUniqueValue(),
            number: current.getValue('number'),
            event_type: String(event.parm2)
        };

        var request = new sn_ws.RESTMessageV2(
            'AI Incident Orchestrator S1.3 Event',
            'post'
        );

        request.setEndpoint(endpoint);
        request.setRequestBody(JSON.stringify(outboundEvent));

        var response = request.execute();
        var statusCode = response.getStatusCode();

        if (statusCode >= 200 && statusCode < 300) {
            gs.info(
                'S1.3 outbound event sent: ' +
                outboundEvent.event_id +
                ' status=' +
                statusCode
            );
        } else {
            gs.error(
                'S1.3 outbound event failed: ' +
                outboundEvent.event_id +
                ' status=' +
                statusCode
            );
        }

    } catch (ex) {
        gs.error(
            'S1.3 outbound event error: ' +
            ex.message
        );
    }

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>incident</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>AI Incident Orchestrator - Evaluate Elig</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous) {

    var RELEVANT_FIELDS = [
        'active',
        'category',
        'x_2215032_ai_inc_0_ai_enabled',
        'x_2215032_ai_inc_0_ai_processing_state',
        'x_2215032_ai_inc_0_ai_human_lock',
        'x_2215032_ai_inc_0_ai_retry_count'
    ];

    var SUPPORTED_CATEGORIES_PROPERTY =
        'x_2215032_ai_inc_0.s1_3_supported_categories';

    var CATEGORY_PATTERN =
        /^[a-z0-9]+(?:[-_][a-z0-9]+)*$/;

    var PROCESSING_STATE =
        'x_2215032_ai_inc_0_ai_processing_state';

    var RETRY_COUNT =
        'x_2215032_ai_inc_0_ai_retry_count';

    function getSupportedCategories() {
        var configuredValue = String(
            gs.getProperty(
                SUPPORTED_CATEGORIES_PROPERTY,
                ''
            ) || ''
        );

        var categories = configuredValue
            .split(',')
            .map(function trimCategory(category) {
                return category.trim();
            })
            .filter(function removeEmptyCategory(category) {
                return category.length > 0;
            });

        if (
            categories.length === 0 ||
            categories.some(
                function hasMalformedCategory(category) {
                    return !CATEGORY_PATTERN.test(category);
                }
            )
        ) {
            return [];
        }

        return categories;
    }

    function hasRelevantUpdate() {
        for (var i = 0; i < RELEVANT_FIELDS.length; i++) {
            var fieldName = RELEVANT_FIELDS[i];

            if (
                current.getValue(fieldName) !==
                previous.getValue(fieldName)
            ) {
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    function suppress(current, reason) {
        gs.info(
            'S1.3 eligibility suppressed: ' +
            reason +
            ' number=' +
            current.getValue('number') +
            ' sys_id=' +
            current.getUniqueValue()
        );
    }

    var operation = current.operation();

    if (operation === 'update') {

        if (!previous) {
            suppress(current, 'previous_unavailable');
            return;
        }

        if (!hasRelevantUpdate()) {
            return;
        }
    }

    var processingState =
        current.getValue(PROCESSING_STATE);

    var category =
        current.getValue('category');

    var humanLock =
        current.getValue(
            'x_2215032_ai_inc_0_ai_human_lock'
        );

    var retryValue =
        current.getValue(RETRY_COUNT);

    var retryCount =
        parseInt(retryValue || '0', 10);

    if (current.getValue('active') !== '1') {
        suppress(current, 'inactive');
        return;
    }

    if (
        current.getValue(
            'x_2215032_ai_inc_0_ai_enabled'
        ) !== '1'
    ) {
        suppress(current, 'ai_disabled');
        return;
    }

    if (processingState === 'complete') {
        suppress(current, 'already_processed');
        return;
    }

    if (
        getSupportedCategories().indexOf(category) === -1
    ) {
        suppress(current, 'unsupported_category');
        return;
    }

    if (processingState === 'in_progress') {
        suppress(current, 'already_running');
        return;
    }

    if (processingState === 'awaiting_approval') {
        suppress(current, 'awaiting_approval');
        return;
    }

    if (
        processingState !== 'pending' &&
        processingState !== 'failed'
    ) {
        suppress(current, 'invalid_processing_state');
        return;
    }

    if (isNaN(retryCount) || retryCount < 0) {
        suppress(current, 'invalid_retry_count');
        return;
    }

    /*
     * Failed processing is a retry only when the record
     * newly transitions into Failed.
     */
    if (
        processingState === 'failed' &&
        operation === 'update'
    ) {
        var previousProcessingState =
            previous.getValue(PROCESSING_STATE);

        /*
         * An unrelated edit while already Failed must
         * not generate another retry.
         */
        if (previousProcessingState === 'failed') {
            return;
        }

        var previousRetryValue =
            previous.getValue(RETRY_COUNT);

        var previousRetryCount =
            parseInt(
                previousRetryValue || '0',
                10
            );

        if (
            isNaN(previousRetryCount) ||
            previousRetryCount < 0
        ) {
            suppress(current, 'invalid_retry_count');
            return;
        }

        /*
         * Count before this failure determines whether
         * another retry is available.
         *
         * previous 0 -> Retry 1
         * previous 1 -> Retry 2
         * previous 2 -> exhausted
         */
        if (previousRetryCount >= 2) {
            suppress(current, 'retry_limit_exhausted');
            return;
        }
    }

    if (humanLock === '1') {
        suppress(current, 'human_locked');
        return;
    }

    var eventType =
        operation === 'insert'
            ? 'incident.created'
            : 'incident.updated';

    var eventId =
        gs.generateGUID();

    gs.info(
        'S1.3 eligibility passed: ' +
        eventType +
        ' event_id=' +
        eventId
    );

    gs.eventQueue(
        'x_2215032_ai_inc_0.s1_3_outbound_event',
        current,
        eventId,
        eventType
    );

})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-11 14:04:17</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>a109b9c583dbc310b5309e80ceaad339</sys_id><sys_mod_count>8</sys_mod_count><sys_name>AI Incident Orchestrator - Evaluate Elig</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="AI Incident Orchestrator" source="x_2215032_ai_inc_0">51a63bbf738bc7502aedfed25ab8b789</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="AI Incident Orchestrator">51a63bbf738bc7502aedfed25ab8b789</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_a109b9c583dbc310b5309e80ceaad339</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-12 02:04:55</sys_updated_on><template/><when>after</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=a109b9c583dbc310b5309e80ceaad339"/></record_update>

    var AI_ENABLED =
        'x_2215032_ai_inc_0_ai_enabled';

    var HUMAN_LOCK =
        'x_2215032_ai_inc_0_ai_human_lock';

    var SUPPORTED_CATEGORIES_PROPERTY =
        'x_2215032_ai_inc_0.s1_3_supported_categories';

        /^[a-z0-9]+(?:[-_][a-z0-9]+)*$/;

    if (processingState !== 'failed') {
        return;
    }

    if (!previous) {
        return;
    }

    if (
        previous.getValue(PROCESSING_STATE) === 'failed'
    ) {
        return;
    }

    var retryValue =
        current.getValue(RETRY_COUNT);

    var retryCount =
        parseInt(retryValue || '0', 10);

    /*
     * Invalid retry state fails closed and escalates
     * to human review.
     */
    if (
        isNaN(retryCount) ||
        retryCount < 0
    ) {
        current.setValue(
            HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED,
            '1'
        );

        gs.info(
            'S1.3 retry escalation: invalid_retry_count'
        );

        return;
    }

    /*
     * Two retries have already been consumed.
     * Do not increment again. Escalate instead.
     */
    if (retryCount >= 2) {
        current.setValue(
            HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED,
            '1'
        );

        gs.info(
            'S1.3 retry escalation: retry_limit_exhausted'
        );

        return;
    }

    /*
     * Only consume a retry if the Incident is otherwise
     * eligible for AI processing.
     */
    if (
        current.getValue('active') !== '1'
    ) {
        return;
    }

    if (
        current.getValue(AI_ENABLED) !== '1'
    ) {
        return;
    }

    if (
        getSupportedCategories().indexOf(
            current.getValue('category')
        ) === -1
    ) {
        return;
    }

    if (
        current.getValue(HUMAN_LOCK) === '1'
    ) {
        return;
    }

    /*
     * This is a BEFORE Business Rule.
     * Updating current here becomes part of the same
     * Incident save, so no current.update() is needed.
     *
     * 0 -> 1 = Retry 1 consumed
     * 1 -> 2 = Retry 2 consumed
     */
    current.setValue(
        RETRY_COUNT,
        String(retryCount + 1)
    );

    gs.info(
        'S1.3 retry count advanced: ' +
        retryCount +
        ' -> ' +
        (retryCount + 1)
    );

})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-11 22:38:38</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>e68f23c1839b0710b5309e80ceaad3d2</sys_id><sys_mod_count>5</sys_mod_count><sys_name>AI Incident Orchestrator - Retry Escalat</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="AI Incident Orchestrator" source="x_2215032_ai_inc_0">51a63bbf738bc7502aedfed25ab8b789</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="AI Incident Orchestrator">51a63bbf738bc7502aedfed25ab8b789</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_e68f23c1839b0710b5309e80ceaad3d2</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-12 02:02:38</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=e68f23c1839b0710b5309e80ceaad3d2"/></record_update>
